notes:
v4.6.10 — Universe tab gets a script picker

✨ NEW
• Universe tab now has a 'Run which universe script' dropdown. Lists the built-in universe_manager.py at the top, then every custom universe generator you've created via Make Bot (kind=Universe). Selecting a different script swaps which file the RUN button executes — no need to replace your default universe_manager.py. Selection is sticky across app restarts.
• Each item shows its META description as a subtitle so you remember what each universe bot does (e.g. 'crypto_momentum → rewrites crypto_universe.txt — Picks top-volume crypto on positive 7d return').
• ↻ refresh button next to the dropdown rescans DATA_DIR/universe_scripts/ in case you just generated a new one.

Includes v4.6.9's delete-bot fix + v4.6.8's paper/live toggle + marketplace own-bot republish.
